name: Pine Ridge Loop
description: A short, shaded loop through red pine stands with a gentle climb to a lakeside overlook. Great for a quick morning walk.

name: Potawatomi Trail
description: Rolling hardwood forest and glacial lakes on a well-marked singletrack shared with mountain bikers. Expect a few steep, rooty sections.

name: Brighton Ridge Trail
description: A long, hilly route with repeated ridge climbs and sandy descents. Bring plenty of water; there is no shade on the southern half.

name: Mill Creek Path
description: A flat, crushed-gravel path along Mill Creek with boardwalk wetland crossings. Stroller and beginner friendly.

name: Lakelands Ridge Trail
description: Open meadows and oak savanna along an old rail corridor, with a side spur up to a ridge-top view of the Waterloo hills.

name: Waterloo-Pinckney Traverse
description: A full-day point-to-point section of the long Waterloo-Pinckney trail through forest, marsh and steep moraine hills.
